findings.evidence: Lines 260–261 return `q.card` for `.twistedA`, whereas lines 25–27 say its matrix realization is over `q²` elements and `q` is the Frobenius parameter.
findings.fix: Describe this accessor consistently as the Frobenius/classification parameter `q` (and the Suzuki–Ree field order), explicitly noting that it is not the extension-field cardinality used by twisted matrix realizations; update the module summary likewise.
findings.issue: The docstring calls `fieldOrder` “the order of the field of definition,” but for `twistedA` it returns `q.card`, while lines 25–27 state that `²A₂(q)` is realized over the field with `q²` elements; line 19 repeats the ambiguous “field order” description.

summary: The `fieldOrder` documentation misidentifies the Frobenius parameter as the order of the construction field, contradicting the module’s own twisted-family convention.
